name: Overreach
purpose: A fixture component's authored half. It carries every authored field the schema requires, so that the aligned contract is a complete one rather than a minimal one.
responsibilities: Stand still while the gate reads it.
do: Read it as an example of the shape, never of the content.
dont: Do not copy its prose into a real contract. It describes a fixture.

do_not_use_when.when: You are looking for an example of judgment rather than of shape.

alternatives.for: an example of what a contract says

constraints: Nothing here is a decision about anything.

behaviour: Logical properties only, like everything outside legacy/.
does_not_mirror: Whatever it is handed. Mirroring is the icon's own flag.

deprecation.policy: Deleted when the gate no longer needs it.

generated.note: Build output. Edit the component or the authored half and regenerate; an edit made here is overwritten by the next run and reported by check-contracts.mjs in the meantime.
